Ministry of Truth · Filing

Terminal Dossier

Data provenance, what is verified, what is not, and how the randomiser thinks.

What this is

An independent Helldivers 2 companion terminal: a validated loadout randomiser, a Warbond archive that mirrors the in-game reward pages, and a local ownership register. It is a fan project, not affiliated with Arrowhead Game Studios or Sony.

Deployment rules enforced

  • Maximum one support weapon and one backpack per loadout.
  • A support weapon that ships with its own ammo backpack counts against both limits: choose one and every other support weapon and backpack is locked out.
  • No duplicate stratagems in one loadout.
  • A loadout does not have to include a support weapon or a backpack.
  • The sampler picks uniformly across every legal four-stratagem set, so no eligible stratagem is silently favoured or starved.

Data sources

    Verification status

    Known limits

    • Equipment art and names are the property of Arrowhead Game Studios. Artwork is referenced from the community wiki and used here for identification only.
    • Helmets, capes, emotes, cards, patterns and titles are catalogued so the Warbond pages look right, but they are cosmetic and never randomised.
    • Boosters are catalogued but not randomised, because a booster is not part of the four-slot stratagem selection this terminal models.
    • Warbond release order and reward layouts follow the community wiki snapshot noted above. New Warbonds need a data refresh; nothing here is invented to fill a gap.

    Keyboard

    G generate · 1–5 switch section · ←/→ flip Warbond pages · Esc close · right-click inside a Warbond goes back.
